title: BIM Modeler
purpose: Author and maintain discipline BIM model content within governed workflows. Discipline-focused production role creating and updating 3D geometry, views, and documentation under the direction of Discipline Leads and BIM governance. Responsible for local modeling craft and compliance with standards.
authority_statements: Create, edit, and delete BIM model elements within assigned discipline scope under Discipline Lead direction
Apply project and enterprise BIM standards (naming, structure, families, parameters) to authored content
Propose modeling approaches and content improvements to Discipline Leads and BIM roles
May approve local modeling choices within design and governance constraints that do not change discipline intent or BIM standards
May approve internal discipline views, working sets, and temporary elements used for design development
May reject model changes that conflict with discipline design intent
May reject requests to use non-compliant content or modeling practices that break agreed BIM standards
May not override BIM governance decisions made by BIM Director and Project BIM Manager
May not override coordination requirements and acceptance criteria defined by Project BIM Coordinator / BIM Detailer
May not override discipline design decisions made by Discipline Leads
May not override contractual scope, deadlines, and acceptance decisions made by Project Leadership
responsibilities: Author and maintain 3D and 2D BIM content for assigned discipline/system following Discipline Lead instructions and BIM standards
Use governed BIM content (families, templates, annotation) and parameter schemes provided by BIM governance and BIM Detailers
Maintain model health within assigned scope by applying good modeling practices (clean geometry, appropriate categories, worksets)
Respond to coordination issues and clash resolutions by updating discipline models in line with recorded decisions
Prepare and maintain discipline design views and documentation views needed for reviews, coordination, and production
Flag missing content, problematic standards, or recurring modeling issues
Collaborate with BIM Detailers when specialized production support is needed (bulk parameters, complex families, export setups)
Maintain traceability of significant model changes within CDE and project workflows
accountabilities: Execution craft and technical quality of authored discipline models
Compliance of authored geometry and parameters with project BEP and standards
Prompt execution of agreed clash fixes and coordination updates
approvals: Local modeling choices and temporary internal working views
inputs: Design intent directives from Discipline Lead
Approved families, templates, and shared parameter files
Assigned issues and clash viewpoints from Project BIM Coordinator
outputs: Authored BIM elements and submodels within assigned scope
Working design views, discipline working sets, and draft documentation views

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.
